data.body: AC amendment: Installer overwrite semantics — create-dso-app.sh writes merge.strategy=direct and enforcement.strategy=local using append-if-absent pattern (grep for key first; only write if not already present). This prevents silently clobbering a user's existing config on re-run. Add a note and update test: test_installer_writes_merge_strategy_defaults should verify that re-running with pre-existing merge.strategy=pr leaves that key unchanged.
